title: The night of the Scales
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: night on the deck of an ancient airship beneath the stars. D.E.R.E.K. reaches toward the faintly glowing Scales of Judgement while Ulrick, woken from sleep, catches his wrist with a steady hand; behind Ulrick, little B.0.B. peeks out. Quiet, tense, tender. Characters: D.E.R.E.K. (Chadron): a humanoid golden construct with a smooth metal face, a single large glowing blue eye and full red lips, in hooded red-and-orange robes with clockwork and clock-face motifs. Ulrick: a broad-shouldered human paladin with short swept-back dark brown hair and a full dark beard, in heavy dark plate armour with bronze-orange pauldrons and a long white tabard. B.0.B.: a small round brass construct about knee height with one large eye, red lips and thin clockwork limbs, hovering slightly off the ground.
